items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of taxi travel costs
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit unserer Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, legen Sie bitte innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der BKK Musterwerk, Am Werkstor 12, 38440 Beispielsburg.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Wed 2025-05-07 by a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X. Deemed delivery = 4th day after posting = Sun 2025-05-11. Unlike tax offices, the delivery day for social-law bodies does NOT move even though it falls on a Sunday (BSG B 14 AS 12/09 R). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs from that delivery day; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same date number as the delivery day: 2025-06-11 (Wednesday). This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.

warnings: The letter rejects the reimbursement request and states no payment is due; there is no monetary amount to extract from this letter.
